SUMMARY

Robinhood Markets, Inc.(HOOD+1.85%)reported record quarterly revenue and adjusted EBITDA as the company expanded its financial services platform into prediction markets and decentralized exchange services. Management reported that the company achieved a record for net deposits within the first 10 months of the year, surpassing its 20% annual growth target. The company launched the Robinhood Chain and introduced peer-to-peer payment capabilities that allow recipients to accept funds via mobile wallets without requiring a Robinhood account. The company also announced a new equity partnership with crypto.com and og.com to provide secondary exchange liquidity for its prediction markets.

Full Conference Call Transcript

Operator:Thank you to everyone for joining Robinhood's Q3 2026 Earnings Call, whether you're tuning into the live stream or here with us in Menlo Park. With us today are Chairman and CEO, Vlad Tenev; CFO, Shiv Verma; and VP of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations, Chris Koegel. Vlad and Shiv will offer opening remarks and then open the call to Q&A. During the Q&A portion of the call, we'll answer questions from the audience, which includes institutional research analysts, finance content creators who may hold an ownership position in Robinhood and both institutional and retail shareholders. As a reminder, today's call will contain forward-looking statements.

Actual results could differ materially from our current expectations, and we may not provide updates unless legally required. Potential risk factors that could cause differences, including regulatory developments that we continue to monitor are described in the press release we issued today, the earnings presentation and our SEC filings, all of which can be found at investors.robinhood.com. Today's discussion will also include non-GAAP financial measures. Reconciliations to the GAAP measures we consider most directly comparable can be found in the earnings presentation. With that, please welcome Vlad.

Vladimir Tenev:All right. Thank you guys for coming. This is awesome, and it's great to see so many people in person. We're back at our headquarters in sunny Menlo Park. So thank you again for being on this journey with us and showing up in person and to everyone watching remotely. So as you probably know, at Robinhood, we have a singular goal. We believe in ownership. We want to make everyone an owner. And we think that broad ownership is actually essential to a free, stable and prosperous society. So in order to execute on this vision, we have our three-part strategy. So to recap that, the first part, we want to build the #1 active trader platform.

So we want to allow customers to own any tradable asset. And really an active trader should feel like they're at a disadvantage trading elsewhere. So we'll have more about that later. Second, strategic arc, #1 in wallet share for the next generation. So we want to build our customers' financial home and not just for them, but for their families as well. Then the third, one global financial ecosystem. So take the ownership that we've been able to deliver and grow in the U.S. and expand it everywhere around the world. Q3, we made a lot of progress. So our product velocity continued across each of these three arcs, and we saw strong business and financial results.

So for active traders, again, the idea is if you're an active trader, you're at a disadvantage trading elsewhere. So what have we done for active traders? Last month, we held our third annual HOOD Summit event in Houston, Texas. And we launched not 1, not 2, but 17 new products and new services to our customers. So I'll hit a couple of highlights. Agentic Trading, which is near and dear to my heart, literally, I'm wearing the vest right now. So our Agentic offerings have really increased in scope over the course of the year. If you remember, we started with our MCP, which has grown quite well.

And now we've got Agentic Trading directly in the app, so you no longer need to use your external tool like your Claude Code and Codex. You can do it within the app. And we've also allowed customers to extend their MCP connectivity to Robinhood Legend. So Robinhood Legend is now in scope for our MCP connectors as well. So we're just continuing to make it easier for anyone to trade on our platform, whether it's you directly or your agent. And while we're still very early in the in-app capabilities and the harness tooling, we've been seeing really strong early adoption across the entire suite of Agentic products. So customers have over 250 million in Agentic accounts.

Remember, this is -- the account start at zero. So you have to make a choice to move money into them. And we look at the adoption curves, both across usage and trading, and they're sort of following an accelerating curve, which gets us very excited about the future of these products. And as we continue to add more asset classes, more features, those curves appear to be steepening. Next, perpetual futures. So we became the first U.S. broker to offer what we call true perpetual futures. So these are perpetuals powered by our global derivatives exchange Bitstamp, and they settle continuously around the day. So 15-minute settlement. We're also working on adding earnings contracts to our prediction markets hub.

I think this will be particularly relevant for this audience because they'll allow you to trade EPS and revenue on individual companies as well as KPIs that are company specific. And of course, something I've been very excited about for quite some time. We announced 24/7 equity trading that will be coming to Robinhood later this year. And again, this is something -- I think we'll be the first to offer this as well. And these are just a few of the many items we've shipped. So there's a lot more, and I encourage you all to check out the full keynote on YouTube or X if you haven't already. So let's move to wallet share.

A couple of things that I'd like to highlight here. Trump accounts achieved a really important milestone in Q3, auto enrollment. So as we said before, we've got nearly 70 million children in the U.S. under the age of 18 that are eligible for the Trump account. And now the U.S. Treasury has opened accounts for all of them, for all these children. And because of the generous gift from Michael and Susan Dell through their foundation, 25 million of those children already had $250 invested for them by the Dell Foundation. So we're excited about this initiative. It's one of those things where it's just been snowballing and we're doing more.

So there's just a ton of road map ahead. One of the things I'm particularly excited about is I think it can become the default vehicle for philanthropic giving in this country, right? And we're already seeing the beginnings of that with the Dell's, but also the other donors -- and we don't really have a great default option. I think Trump accounts can become that. So we're going to be doing more there in partnership with BNY and the U.S. government. We're also continuing to make progress with Robinhood Gold, which today is one of the largest paid membership programs in consumer finance in the U.S.

So a couple of years ago, we set out to actually completely revamp our gold product. And what we wanted to do is put something in gold for our mass market customer so that you didn't have to be an active trader to benefit from gold. And I think we've been able to achieve that. So in this quarter, Robinhood Gold reached 5 million subscribers. okay? We see it really paying off. We see it paying off. We've got 5 million gold subscribers. And that's up over 30% year-over-year, and it's a 4x increase from when we began the journey to revamp the gold program just about 4 years ago.

So that gets us to about an 18% overall gold adoption rate when you look at our customer base, but 40% if you look at in quarter. So of the customers that joined Robinhood in quarter, much higher adoption. And that's really great to see because then we see a path as we continue to grow, gold will just continue to increase. And I think there's actually much more room to grow. Our big bets for growing the gold value proposition are banking and credit. And those are still despite getting to large scale, not generally available yet. So there's still limited release. And we've been really investing in more integration points.

So things like easy sign-up for banking and Gold card if you're signing up for Robinhood, contextual upsells so that we detect when banking and credit is going to be appropriate for you when you're using the Robinhood app and kind of putting it there. So we think we've got plenty of room to run. These can become even more meaningful drivers of higher gold adoption. Finally, let me get to global financial ecosystem. So on July 1, just a few months ago, we launched the Robinhood chain Mainnet. And in its first quarter, it's already a top 5 chain by volume and revenue. So far, we've seen over $100 billion in DEX volume.

So it's $100 billion in decentralized exchange trading volume and over $50 million in chain fees. DeFi perpetuals, it's an interesting innovative product, have seen solid growth on the chain as well. So in recent weeks, we've been seeing DeFi perpetuals volume of over $1 billion per day on the chain. So it's clear customers have demand for these tokenized assets on chain. And we think we not only believe we're building Robinhood chain to be the best place to own and trade all of these tokenized assets, of course, starting with stock tokens and perpetuals, but expanding much broader from that. We're also expanding our brokerage infrastructure globally.

And we're excited with that to announce that we received authorization from the Dubai Financial Services Authority to launch Robinhood in the region. This will broaden our international footprint even further. The product velocity that you've been seeing and the focus on the customer experience have led to really strong business results. Market share continues to grow, up double digits year-over-year for each of the main assets, equities, options, crypto and margin as well. Revenues grew 12% year-over-year to a record $1.4 billion. Adjusted EBITDA, that's up 9%, record of over $800 million. And then net deposits, $16 billion in the quarter.

And with a strong start to Q4, which Shiv will talk more about, we have already exceeded our annual goal of 20% net deposit growth, and that's with 2 months left to go. So we're pleased with the strong results for our customers and for our business. We're pushing hard to make Robinhood your financial super app. So with that, I'll ask Shiv to come up. How are you doing, sir?

Shiv Verma:All right. All right. So thank you, Vlad. Before we get into the results, I just wanted to share three big takeaways from Q3. First, as Vlad said, the core business is firing on all cylinders. This led to our highest quarter ever for both revenue and adjusted EBITDA and really great to see platform assets were nearly $400 billion. And on top of that, we set new records for equities, options, event contracts and margin. So going well all around. Second, our product is driving a more diversified business.

We're now up to 14 cylinders that have reached $100 million or more of annualized revenue as Rothera, our prediction markets exchange, hit this number in just its full -- first full quarter of operations. So really nice to see Rothera scaling well. And then finally, we drove another quarter of strong growth, profitability and scale. So we're a Rule of 80 company, but at our scale of over $5.5 billion of annualized revenue. So we remain disciplined on expenses even while investing for growth, which is fantastic to see. So let's get to our Q3 results, and all of these will be compared to a year ago.

So revenues were up 12% to a record $1.4 billion, and this was driven by strong growth in both new products and existing products as well. Transaction revenues were a record as trading volumes were new highs across equities, options and margin. Each of these was up around 50% year-over-year, and this was on market share gains. And the event contracts continue to scale really nicely. This was up 7x year-over-year. Additionally, the Robinhood chain in its first quarter of adoption saw really strong usage, as Vlad mentioned before. So that was another driver of transaction revenue in the quarter.

And then on NIM or net interest revenues, really strong growth in margin, credit card book and Robinhood Banking, and these grew to new record balances. And our total interest-earning assets on the platform also hit new highs. So really nice to see both transaction revenue and the interest-earning assets do well. And then finally, in other revenues, as Vlad shared before, Gold subscribers reached a new all-time high of over 4 million subs, which is great to see. And then additionally, as we continue to build and expand the Trump accounts for customers, that generates some additional revenue as well. And so while revenues grew to a quarterly record, we also see discipline on costs.

And so adjusted OpEx in SBC was managed to $664 million. This was managed within our prior outlook range. And again, as we're investing for growth, we're still being really, really disciplined on our expenses. And our productivity also continues to do really well. So in this quarter, we hit revenue per employee of nearly $2 million, which would be a new record. So we're shipping for customers, but we're also doing it in our lean and disciplined way. And then finally, as we look ahead to Q4, while we plan to continue making growth investments, in particular, in the Trump accounts, we're also controlling our expenses and have driven more efficiencies across our business.

So as we do that, we're going to lower the top end of our prior outlook range by $25 million, and we now expect full year adjusted OpEx in SBC to be between $2.675 billion and $2.75 billion, and this is $13 million lower at the midpoint versus our prior outlook. So you put them together, really strong top line growth, expense discipline, and this led to a strong quarter of profitability. So adjusted EBITDA was a record $808 million. This is up 9% year-over-year, and adjusted EBITDA margin continues to be strong at 57% in Q3. EPS for the quarter was $0.51. Now this includes a minus $0.07 of mark-to-market impact on investments that we hold.

And so as we talk about EPS, we're continuing to expand our business into investments. One of them is such as Robinhood Ventures. And as we launch more and more of these products, we're now seeing some nonoperating movements on these investments. So we're introducing adjusted EPS, and this is to just better reflect our core operating profitability before any gains or losses on investments or some of these other nonoperating items. But at the same time, we're going to remain accountable for all of our regular ongoing costs. So we're still including normal course SBC in our adjusted EPS. As I've said before many times, share count and the denominator matters.

And so you put it all together, in Q3, adjusted EPS was $0.60. And so moving forward, we hope that investors find this a useful measure of our core profitability in the business. Another area I wanted to touch upon is prediction markets. We believe it's really early innings for the asset class, and we're investing to be a leader in the space. We're constantly improving the in-app experience. We now have a vertically integrated exchange with Rothera. And as I mentioned before, it's off to a great start. Additionally, we also announced a recent partnership with crypto.com and og.com. Now this is really exciting for both our customers, but also for our business and shareholders.

It's really important for us that customers have a best-in-class selection with consistent pricing across exchanges and with these partnerships that now allows us to do that. But additionally, with no cash outlay, we received an initial 1% equity ownership stake in crypto.com and og.com. And we have the ability to earn up to 10% ownership depending on how much we partner together in the years to come. So before we move to Q&A, I just wanted to give a little bit about how Q4 looks to start following a record Q3.

October net deposits are over $13 billion in the month, great to see, and that includes $6 billion of the Dell family gift to Trump accounts, as Vlad mentioned earlier. And this brings our total year-to-date net deposits to over $68 billion. This is already a new annual record and north of our 20% growth target with just a few months -- with still a few months to go left in the year. And then compared to Q3, average daily volumes for equities, options and cryptos are off to a good start and are about 5% lighter relative to the really strong Q3. And then event contract ADVs are already up about 10% to start the quarter.

So stepping back, it was great to see another strong quarter in Q3, and we're really excited about our momentum entering Q4. And as we've shared before, our financial North Star remains the same, maximize earnings per share and free cash flow per share for shareholders over time. All right. Chris, Vlad, should we take some questions?

Chris Koegel:All right. Thank you.

Vladimir Tenev:Let's do it.

Chris Koegel:For the Q&A session, we'll start by answering shareholder questions from Say Technologies. And after the questions, we'll turn to live questions from our audience and then go to the dial-in queue. So I'll kick it off with our first question from , which comes from Bo Shen. Okay. I think we've lost Bo. So Bo asked, how is the expansion into banking going? And when will features such as the Zelle replacement arrive?

Vladimir Tenev:It's a great question. So I thought rather than talking about it, I'll actually just show you. I try not to launch new products during earnings, but I thought since we have a crowd here, I might as well give you a little bit more. By the way, before I get into it, I do want to say one thing about banking as it pertains to our super app vision. So one of the things we've been tracking for a really long time is what the top bank withdrawal destinations for our brokerage business have been. So this is the top institutions that people actually move money from brokerage into banking.

And for the longest time, it's been kind of the expected big banks, not a huge surprise there. But as we've started to roll out Robinhood Banking, we've actually seen Robinhood Banking climbing up the list. And this quarter, for the first time, Robinhood Banking became the #1 withdrawal destination for Robinhood brokerage customers. This is actually even before it's generally available. So it is the #1 bank that customers withdraw money to by dollars, which I think is quite amazing. And obviously, we love this because that money is not leaving the Robinhood ecosystem. It just stays in people's accounts.

And I think it's one major proof point that customers are choosing Robinhood for their totality of their financial needs. They're coming in, they're direct depositing their paycheck. They have their checking and savings account. Of course, they move money to invest and trade. They do their spending with gold and now Platinum. So increasingly, you don't really have to leave Robinhood because we offer best-in-class services kind of across the board. Now one thing that people have been asking about is peer-to-peer payments. And of course, we didn't want to just do like a regular add-on bolt-on peer-to-peer payments feature. We wanted to make it really, really nice. So if you guys are ready, I can share my screen.

So this is Robinhood banking. So I've blurred out my balances. This is the new design, by the way. We've updated it to have the liquid glass UI. So there's this button on the bottom right, which is kind of your overall transaction action button. And if you open that, you see there's this new send money feature. So, Matt, can I send you -- would you accept a few dollars for me?

Unknown Executive:Sure. Yes, I don't know how much you like me based on how much you send.

Vladimir Tenev:Okay, good. You know I like you a moderate amount. So it's just as simple as that. I'll send Matt, who's been doing a great job from our Investor Relations team, $5 from my joint checking account, okay? And you can put a little message here. Of course, this is my favorite one. And so check this out. So I'm going to send it via text. One of the really annoying things about peer-to-peer payments, I don't know if you guys have experienced this, but you want to use an app and the person you send money to doesn't have it, which creates this like moment of friction. I don't want them to have to install anything.

And then they'll ask you, can you send it this way? Can you do it with one of the competitors and then you have to install it. Anyway, we've gotten rid of all of that, Matt, if you -- did you get it?

Unknown Executive:I got the text.

Vladimir Tenev:Okay. If you want to show -- so there it is, he just taps on it, and you can accept money with Apple Pay or Google Pay without even having a Robinhood banking account, which is pretty awesome if you think about it. Of course, it gives us an opportunity to upsell Robinhood Banking, which is just a really clean experience for those of you that have tried it, but you don't have to have it. You can just get it right into your Apple Pay. So you don't have to worry about that friction of the recipient of the funds. So right now, still in limited release. If Matt sends money to someone, they'll get it.

But yes, you should expect to see us rolling this out much more broadly in the coming weeks. And just another reason why everything we think can be better on Robinhood if you do more and more of your -- if you run more of your financial life through us.

Shiv Verma:Who needs sell, right?

Vladimir Tenev:Yes. I mean legacy technology, I think we can do better if we build everything in an integrated fashion.

Chris Koegel:All right. Great demo. All right. So the next question is from Marcus M, who asks, how is global expansion going? And what countries are next?

Vladimir Tenev:Yes. So I'll field that one. So when Shiv and I were kind of coming up with our plan and we thought what can Robinhood be in 10 years, we called our third arc global financial ecosystem. And we -- our vision, and I think this is backed up by how big these markets are and also sort of like wealth accumulation, people outside the U.S. keep getting wealthier. Our vision is that over the long run, more than half of our business should be outside the U.S. And cut another way, more than half should be institutional. And what we didn't anticipate is products like Robinhood Chain, right?

And we said Robinhood Chain already in quarter got out of the gate really quick with $100 billion in DEX volume and $50 million of chain fees, right? And you think about how much -- and we're actually continuing to invest, frankly, the growth of the chain and associated ecosystem and the wallet surprised and sort of like -- was higher than our expectations. And so now we're spending a lot of time investing in how to make that even bigger, how to support the community. We know we've been hearing from a lot of builders that we could be doing more to support the community.

And I think you should expect to see us really ramp that up because we want to make it the best developer ecosystem as well as the best sort of global on-chain community. So yes, you should expect to see us ramping the investment because you just don't see growth of a new ecosystem like this. It's an uncommon thing. I mean a lot of chains have launched over the past few months. that have just had not nearly like an incomparably small level of traction compared to this. So we're doubling down on that.

And of course, as I mentioned earlier, we're expanding into MENA with our Dubai license, and we did get in principle approval from MAS to expand into Singapore, and that will be our Southeast Asia APAC hub, which we're very excited about. And by the way, we're continuing to get deeper in our more established markets of EU and U.K. U.K. now has crypto and brokerage in the same offering. So it's getting to parity. And you've seen us actually increasing our download share and getting more traction there.

So it's -- I would say, Shiv, I don't know if you would disagree, I think like for a while, our international business was sort of like a future -- very like far off into the future when we expected to see meaningful contributions. But we're starting to see that accelerate. And I'm seeing the most traction I have. So I feel probably the best that I've ever felt, and we're kind of accelerating so much in momentum there.

Shiv Verma:No, I agree. We built a 10-year plan. It's nice to see the seeds coming. And also Canada, you forgot to mention that as well.

Vladimir Tenev:We're now with the crypto business through the WonderFi acquisition there for sure. So pretty soon, we'll have Robinhood all over the world.

Chris Koegel:All right. Our next question comes from a special guest. You may have seen him driving the Robinhood NEON card during the last two NASCAR seasons, 3-time Cup series race winner and driver of the #23 Toyota for 23XI racing, Bubba Wallace.

Unknown Analyst:Are there any new major product plans for 2027 that could increase Robinhood's revenue?

Vladimir Tenev:No easy questions, Bubba. It's just getting right into it. Yes. And by the way, it was fun watching Bubba compete at the Las Vegas Motor Speedway a couple of weeks ago, hot, but I don't know how he does that for so long. So I would say one of the things that I think people find attractive about Robinhood as a business is that it's a financial compounder, right? Even if you look at the core business of equities, options, crypto, margin, we're continuing to gain in market share. We get more customers. Those customers get wealthier as they get older. The market appreciation adds to that.

So all of this is leading to total platform assets this quarter of about $400 billion. And I don't think it will be long before we're talking over $0.5 trillion and knock on wood into the trillions, right? So just the core brokerage business and the crypto business has been remarkably strong. But we're not just like being complacent and seeing we have a strong core business. We're moving at incredible pace, not just adding all the products and features that our competitors have, but also, I think, just leading the industry across a couple of major domains. I mentioned Agentic Trading earlier.

I think Agentic Trading, I don't think there's really another game in town in terms of financial companies that are really investing in Agentic Trading and making that a first-class experience. So I think we're at the very beginning there, and we're just continuing to invest in making the product experience really, really good. We've talked a lot about prediction markets. I'll also throw in perpetual futures. I mean we're super early to that, right? A lot of companies announce plans to offer these new assets, but we announce and then we ship and we roll out. We're seeing strong traction. That's another asset class where we expect to be the leader and gain market share.

On the wallet share front, you've heard me talk about Trump accounts. Robinhood Ventures is another one where it's just other companies aren't really doing this where they're trying to -- they're going after the vision of democratizing private markets for retail investors. So we have RVI, RVII shipped, and you should expect even more. I mean we are just -- we're really investing because we think it's important, and it's a big business opportunity, a new category that I think we can own. And then, of course, long term in the global financial ecosystem, tokenization and Robinhood Chain and Robinhood Wallet are unique products where it just really feels like we've got the tiger by the tail.

So those are kind of several areas, not just one where we think we can surprise to the upside with the product bets that we're making.

Chris Koegel:All right. Thank you, Vlad. That concludes our Say Technology questions. And now I'd like to go to questions from our live audience. So if you'd like to ask a question, please raise your hand.

Unknown Analyst:I know you've got active trading and you've got the strategy side of things. What are you doing to focus on the middle ground of customers who just kind of want to deposit and forget about it?

Vladimir Tenev:Yes, that's a great question. Actually, that's one thing I forgot to mention. I think Robinhood strategies which is our passive digital advice product. So over $2 billion in assets. It's been growing really quickly year-over-year. I think it's a bit of a dark horse just because we launched so many things. And I think the active trading products tend to get a lot more attention and mind share, but we have all these amazing passive products, strategies being one of them that provides a best-in-class experience. So we've been continuing to add things to the product suite.

We have this tool, Smart Income, which is part of Robinhood Strategies, where you basically just like can just really easily with a slider, just slide your time horizon and risk tolerance, and it will tell you what the sort of like expected return for your investments would be. And then the idea is you just put money in there, you drop money into that account, and it's a complete set it and forget it product. And then I think we've got some things like that team has ambitious plans. There's a bunch of things that we're working on to make that even better. So suffice it to say, strategies isn't staying still.

I think that's -- it's a dark horse product. I think it's one that could surprise people in the coming year.

Chris Koegel:All right. Thank you, Vlad. Next, I think, Hayden, did you have your hand up? Yes. We can get a mic to Hayden.

Unknown Analyst:We've been really impressed by the product velocity and traction at Robinhood, the 14 cylinders over $100 million. Can you speak to how many products your power users engage with versus your average user? And what would it mean for your business if you're able to convert the majority of your customers into power users?

Vladimir Tenev:Yes. I mean that's a great question. We look at this internally quite a bit. And we sort of see that basically the more products that someone uses once you get up to three or four products in the Robinhood ecosystem, the average revenue per user and the engagement just continues to increase with three or four products being really kind of the sweet spot. Also, we can cut it by asset classes. A lot of people come to us to trade equities or crypto first. But then if you look at the customers that trade equities, crypto options, futures and prediction markets, the revenue and the engagement with the platform really increases.

And we've been making a lot of investments, maybe those of you that use Robinhood have been seeing our work there and just making the app more coherent and more discoverable. This is something I mentioned in the last earnings call. We have more work to do because we have all these products, how can we make sure that the app is coherent and that you kind of understand what we're about. Well, I think you're starting to see some of that progress because our shared services, including social, search, home, I think we're doing a much better job in kind of surfacing relevant content to you.

I think the focus has been on making sure prediction markets works really well because we're kind of doing a unique thing like combining this new asset class with other tools that are sort of like personal finance centered. But I think you'll see us continue to invest in personalization and making it easy to discover things in subject to all the rules and regulations, being able to surface relevant content to customers. And I think that's another area where we're best-in-class and continuing to get better.

Shiv Verma:If you want to look in terms of how big it could be, I think gold is the best way to see it. So gold, we don't view it as a subscription product. We view it as a loyalty product. And what you see is a customer comes for something. It doesn't matter whether it's an equity and option a crypto event contract. They discover gold, they then use more products. They then deposit more, they engage more, they trade more. And so for how big it could be, it's great. We have 5 million customers. It's only an 18% attach rate.

And about 40% plus adopt it when they first come in, but there's still a large runway ahead of that.

Chris Koegel:All right. Thank you. Next question.

Unknown Analyst:What is Robinhood's strategy for educating customers about active trading products like perpetual futures or Agentic Trading?

Vladimir Tenev:Yes. I think that what we really try to do is make the products themselves understandable and clear within the app. And I think with our various learning modules and tools, we've done a really good job at taking advantage of the limited real estate of the app and giving people the information they need at the time that they onboard without just like the -- too much of the fluff and filler. Now as we expand into the Agentic products, and actually, one of the reasons I'm excited about Agentic Trading and our investments there is that a lot of our customers are using that as an education tool because these AI agents are really good.

If you just ask them, hey, explain this to me. What is a wheel strategy? What is an option -- like what are the typical options trades? You can say, hey, I have this like plan, this point of view, can you break down, give me like the top 3 ways to capitalize on that. So I think there is strong potential, and we're actually seeing a lot of customers doing this of just explaining things, not even just placing the trade or fully trading autonomously, although we're pushing ahead in that direction, too, but just taking some of this complexity and kind of breaking it down for the customer.
